7399.title: Outline reuse gaps on busy threads
7399.rootCauseOneLine: Status changes invalidate incremental checkpoints; turn-free manager-message history never advances its checkpoint. Completed-turn appends do reuse history.
7399.proposedFix: Define status-safe settled-prefix reuse and checkpoints for thread-scope history, verified against full projection before changing cache keys.
7399.caveats: Two clean database-only reproductions by the same agent; production payload sizes, network latency and browser loading duration unverified. Complete reproduction test is inline in the HTML. No safe simple fix established.
